site.name: Pi Life Tools
site.tagline: Life tools for the Pi ecosystem.

common.disclaimer: Results are estimates for reference only.

dashboard.title: My Life
dashboard.subtitle: Your life tools and data, in one place.
dashboard.lifeScoreEmpty: Use the tools to build your Life Score.
dashboard.recentCardsEmpty: No saved cards yet. Generate one from any tool.

financial-health.name: Financial Health
financial-health.intro: Enter your monthly finances to get a financial health score.

rec.savings: Aim to save at least 10% of your income.
rec.emergency: Build an emergency fund covering 3-6 months of expenses.
rec.debt: Your debt is high relative to income. Consider a payoff plan.
rec.expenses: Your expenses are close to your income. Review your spending.
rec.good: Your financial health looks solid. Keep it up.

compound-interest.name: Compound Interest
compound-interest.tagline: See how savings grow over time.
compound-interest.intro: See how your savings grow with compound interest.
compound-interest.note: Estimates only — not a guarantee of actual investment returns.

goal-planner.name: Goal Planner
goal-planner.tagline: Plan and track your life goals.
goal-planner.intro: Plan and track progress toward a life goal.

life-time.name: Life Time
life-time.tagline: See your life timeline at a glance.
life-time.intro: Reflect on your life timeline. Life expectancy is your own setting, not a prediction.
life-time.note: Life expectancy is a personal setting for reflection — not a medical prediction.

life-days.name: Life Days Calculator
life-days.tagline: See how many days you have lived.
life-days.intro: Enter your date of birth and a calculation date to see how many days, weeks, and approximate years you have lived.
life-days.note: Results are calculated using the complete number of days between the two dates. Years are estimated using an average year of 365.2425 days and are for informational purposes only.

mortgage.name: Mortgage
mortgage.intro: Estimate your monthly mortgage payment and total interest.

debt-payoff.name: Debt Payoff
debt-payoff.tagline: Plan your path out of debt.
debt-payoff.intro: See how long it takes to become debt-free.

life-decision.name: Life Decision
life-decision.tagline: Think through a decision step by step.
life-decision.intro: Rate each factor 1-10 to think through a decision. This is a thinking aid, not an answer.
life-decision.conclusion: This score reflects your own ratings and is not a definitive answer.

time-value.name: Time Value
time-value.tagline: See what your time is worth.
time-value.intro: See what your time is worth and what things really cost in work hours.
time-value.itemResult: A {price} item costs about {hours} work hours.
time-value.summary: Your time is worth about {rate} per hour.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetDataHint: Clears saved cards, history and settings on this device.
settings.resetDone: All local data has been reset.

errors.logicalConflict: These values don't make sense together.
errors.unreachable: This goal cannot be reached with the current inputs.
errors.insufficientPayment: Monthly payment is lower than the interest. Increase the payment to make progress.
errors.storageCorrupted: Saved data was corrupted and has been reset.
errors.piInitFailed: Pi SDK could not start. Tools still work; Pi features are limited.
